operating_book.rationale: Reuse the finite operating-company P/B screening band while normalized FCFF, capital claims and terminal assumptions remain unreviewed; not a peer study or intrinsic model.

property_book.rationale: Reuse the finite property-book screening band; no asset appraisal, project-level RNAV or completed SOTP is implied.

asset_book.rationale: Reuse the finite layered-holding/asset P/B screening band; concession values, ownership claims and funding are not independently underwritten.

MACAY.route_reason: Core beverage cash flows require FCFF; parent book is a separate finite screen.
MACAY.intrinsic_blocker: Recurring margins, capex, working capital, subsidiary minorities and a sustainable terminal bridge are not reconciled.
MACAY.source_warning: PSE PHP4.83 printed BVPS follows consolidated total equity; PHP3.836bn parent equity, not PHP6.239bn total equity, is the book-screen numerator.

DMW.route_reason: Distinct land, development and recurring leasing interests require attributable property SOTP/RNAV.
DMW.intrinsic_blocker: Property-level appraisals, project costs, debt, minority ownership and realization timing are not independently reviewed.
DMW.source_warning: Parent equity excludes PHP6.25bn of non-parent equity; the P/B screen is not an appraised land or leasing value.

HTI.route_reason: Residential inventory and project margins require a property-level valuation; parent book is a separate screen.
HTI.intrinsic_blocker: Project inventory realization, land values, financing and sustainable development margins are not underwritten.
HTI.source_warning: The PSE-reported PHP1.67 BVPS follows total equity; the screen uses PHP3.892bn parent equity. 1H2026 parent income declined year on year.

REDC.route_reason: Hydropower interests require finite concession or asset-life DCF within attributable SOTP.
REDC.intrinsic_blocker: Plant-level generation, concession life, maintenance capex, debt and parent claims are not reconciled.
REDC.source_warning: PSE PHP4.21 BVPS follows total equity; the separate screen uses PHP2.521bn parent equity, not PHP2.737bn total equity.

TOP.route_reason: Fuel-distribution margin, working capital and expansion economics require FCFF; parent book is a separate screen.
TOP.intrinsic_blocker: Unit margins, network capex, working capital and post-IPO capital structure are not underwritten.
TOP.source_warning: Printed PHP0.38 BVPS does not reconcile to June parent equity / September outstanding shares (about PHP0.299); the screen uses that explicit arithmetic bridge. The PSE stock page leaves ISIN blank.

XG.route_reason: Renewable projects require finite-life, funded asset DCF within attributable SOTP.
XG.intrinsic_blocker: Commissioning, generation, concession life, project finance and dilution are not reconciled.
XG.source_warning: PSE PHP0.51 BVPS follows total equity; the screen uses PHP669.3m parent equity. FY2025 parent loss conflicts with a positive displayed basic EPS, so EPS is not used.

HI.route_reason: Banking, education, property and other interests require attributable subsidiary SOTP.
HI.intrinsic_blocker: Subsidiary ownership, debt, minorities, parent-only claims and component market values are not fully reconciled.
HI.source_warning: PSE PHP40.85 BVPS follows PHP60.02bn total equity; the screen uses PHP37.15bn parent equity / 1.469bn outstanding common shares, not 776.8m listed shares.

MBC.route_reason: Advertising and broadcast-franchise cash flows require finite-life FCFF; parent book is a separate screen.
MBC.intrinsic_blocker: Franchise life, advertising cycle, capex, debt and minority claims are not reconciled.
MBC.source_warning: Parent equity exceeds total equity because non-parent equity is negative; reported PHP4.57 BVPS follows total equity. 1H2026 revenue and parent income fell year on year.

LOTO.route_reason: System contracts and lottery-license cash flows require finite-life FCFF; parent book is a separate screen.
LOTO.intrinsic_blocker: Contract duration, license rights, recurring cash flows, capex and parent capital claims are not reconciled.
LOTO.source_warning: PSE-reported PHP1.39 BVPS exceeds June parent equity / September outstanding common shares (about PHP1.271); the screen uses the dated arithmetic bridge. 1H2026 parent income declined.

PRC.route_reason: Racing rights and property interests require finite-life, attributable SOTP rather than a perpetual operating value.
PRC.intrinsic_blocker: Racing license, property appraisal, restructuring, debt and realization timing are not reconciled.
PRC.source_warning: FY2025 and 1H2026 parent losses make earnings multiples unsuitable. Printed PHP9.06 BVPS does not reconcile to June parent equity / September outstanding shares (about PHP8.434), so the dated arithmetic bridge is used.
